s: Cut the zucchini into thin slices (3 mm). Sprinkle lightly with salt, let sit for 10 min to draw out the water, then pat dry with a kitchen towel.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 22–24 cm skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and zucchini for 8–10 min, until tender and lightly golden.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, add the drained vegetables and the parsley, and let sit for 2 min.
Add the last spoonful of oil to the skillet, pour in the mixture and cook for 5–6 min over low heat, loosening the edges.
Place a large plate over the skillet, flip the tortilla over in one confident move, then slide it back into the skillet.
Cook for another 3–4 min and serve warm or cold, cut into wedges.
l01-tortilla-courgette-oignon.p: It keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator: perfect to take along for breakfast or a snack.

l01-omelette-cachir-emmental.t: Omelette with Poultry Kachir and Emmental
i: diced poultry kachir (halal poultry cold cut)
s: Cut the kachir into small dice and brown it dry for 2 min in a skillet over medium heat. Set aside.
Beat the eggs with a small pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in the skillet, pour in the eggs and draw the edges toward the center for 2 min.
Sprinkle with the kachir and Emmental, cover and let the cheese melt for 1 min.
Fold the omelette, sprinkle with parsley and serve cut in half.
l01-omelette-cachir-emmental.p: Choose a good-quality kachir with little starch: read the label, as some contain starch.

s: Pat the shrimp thoroughly dry. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over high heat.
Sauté the shrimp with the garlic and chili for 2 min, until pink. Season with salt and set aside.
Beat the eggs with the parsley, salt and pepper.
Add the remaining oil to the skillet over medium heat, pour in the eggs and let set for 2 min, drawing the edges toward the center.
Spread the shrimp over one half, fold over and leave for 1 min. Serve hot.
l01-omelette-crevettes-ail.p: Frozen shrimp work well: thaw them in the refrigerator the day before and dry them well before cooking.

s: Finely chop all the herbs and the scallion.
Beat the eggs with the herbs, cumin, salt and pepper: the mixture should be very green.
Heat the oil in a 22 cm skillet over medium heat and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook for 3 min without stirring, then cover and continue for 2 min over low heat until the top is set.
Flip onto a plate, cut into wedges and serve hot or cold.
l01-omelette-verte-herbes.p: Inspired by Persian kuku, it is also delicious cold with garlicky Greek yogurt.

l01-oeufs-cocotte-epinards-creme.t: Baked Eggs with Spinach and Cream
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and heat some water for the water bath.
Wilt the spinach for 2 min in a skillet with 10 g of the butter, season with salt, add the nutmeg and squeeze out the water.
Butter 4 ramekins with the remaining butter, divide the spinach among them, then add 1 tbsp cream to each.
Crack an egg into each ramekin, pour another 1 tbsp cream around the yolk, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Place the ramekins in a baking dish, pour in hot water to halfway up the sides and bake for 10–12 min: the white should be set and the yolk runny.
Serve immediately with a spoon.
l01-oeufs-cocotte-epinards-creme.p: Watch the cooking closely: 1 minute too long is enough to firm up the yolk. Take them out while the white still wobbles slightly.

l01-oeufs-cocotte-dinde-fumee-champignon.t: Baked Eggs with Smoked Turkey and Mushrooms
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Sauté the mushrooms in the butter for 5 min over high heat, season with salt and pepper.
Cut the smoked turkey into strips and divide it with the mushrooms among the bottoms of 4 ramekins.
Crack one egg into each ramekin, add 1 tbsp crème fraîche and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake in a water bath for 12–14 min, until the white is set and the cheese is golden.
Add pepper and serve piping hot.
l01-oeufs-cocotte-dinde-fumee-champignon.p: Prepare the mushroom and turkey filling the day before: in the morning all that is left is to crack the eggs.

l01-oeufs-cocotte-tomate-feta.t: Baked Eggs with Tomato, Feta and Oregano
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Sauté the garlic in the oil for 30 s, add the crushed tomatoes and oregano and let reduce for 5 min.
Divide the sauce among 4 ramekins and make a small well in the center of each.
Crack an egg into each well and sprinkle feta all around.
Bake for 10–12 min, until the white is set.
Add pepper, garnish with basil and serve.
l01-oeufs-cocotte-tomate-feta.p: No need to add salt: the feta is enough. Add a pinch of Espelette pepper or harissa for extra kick.

l01-muffins-oeufs-epinards-feta.t: Egg Muffins with Spinach and Feta
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a 12-cup muffin tin (or use a silicone one).
Beat the eggs with the cream, a small pinch of salt and pepper.
Divide the chopped spinach, feta and cherry tomatoes among the cups.
Pour the egg mixture into the cups to three-quarters full.
Bake for 18–20 min, until the muffins are puffed and a knife comes out clean.
Let cool for 5 min before unmolding.
l01-muffins-oeufs-epinards-feta.p: They keep for 4 days in the refrigerator and can be frozen: 30 s in the microwave and breakfast is ready (2 muffins per person).

l01-muffins-oeufs-kefta-poivron.t: Egg Muffins with Kefta and Red Bell Pepper
i: ground kefta meat (spiced ground beef or lamb)
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Sauté the kefta and onion in the oil for 5–6 min over high heat, crumbling the meat, with the cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.
Divide the meat, diced pepper and cilantro among the cups.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them into the cups.
Bake for 18–20 min, until well set and golden.
Unmold after resting for 5 min.
l01-muffins-oeufs-kefta-poivron.p: Great to take to work or school: they are also good cold, with a small cucumber salad.

l01-muffins-oeufs-brocoli-cheddar.t: Egg Muffins with Broccoli and Cheddar
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter a 12-cup muffin tin.
Cook the broccoli florets for 3 min in boiling salted water, drain, then chop coarsely.
Beat the eggs with the cream, mustard, salt and pepper, then stir in two-thirds of the cheddar.
Divide the broccoli among the cups, pour in the egg mixture and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 18–20 min, until the tops are golden.
Let cool for 5 min before unmolding.
l01-muffins-oeufs-brocoli-cheddar.p: Kids love them: chop the broccoli very finely so it goes unnoticed.

s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Grate the zucchini, salt lightly and squeeze hard in a kitchen towel to remove the water.
In a 26 cm ovenproof skillet, heat the oil and sauté the garlic and zucchini for 4 min over medium heat.
Beat the eggs with the shredded mint and pepper, and pour over the zucchini.
Crumble the feta on top and cook for 3–4 min over low heat, without stirring, until the edges set.
Bake for 10–12 min, until the center is set and the surface is golden.
Let rest for 5 min, then cut into wedges.
l01-frittata-courgette-menthe-feta.p: Squeezing the zucchini well prevents a soggy frittata: it is the key step.

l01-frittata-poulet-poivrons.t: Chicken, Bell Pepper and Smoked Paprika Frittata
i: red bell pepper, cut into strips
green bell pepper, cut into strips
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
In a 26 cm ovenproof skillet, sauté the onion and peppers in the oil for 6–7 min over medium heat.
Add the shredded chicken and smoked paprika, season with salt and stir for 1 min.
Pour in the eggs beaten with salt and pepper and let set for 3 min over low heat.
Bake for 12–14 min, until the center is firm.
Let rest for 5 min and serve in wedges, hot or cold.
l01-frittata-poulet-poivrons.p: Ideal for using up leftover roast chicken from dinner.

l01-frittata-chou-fleur-curcuma.t: Cauliflower Frittata with Turmeric and Cilantro
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Steam the cauliflower for 5 min to soften it, then drain well.
In an ovenproof skillet, brown the cauliflower in the oil for 5 min with the turmeric and cumin.
Beat the eggs with the Parmesan, cilantro, salt and pepper, and pour over the cauliflower.
Let set for 3 min over low heat, then bake for 12 min.
Let cool for 5 min and cut into wedges.
l01-frittata-chou-fleur-curcuma.p: Turmeric gives the frittata a lovely yellow color: add a pinch of black pepper to boost its benefits.

l01-oeufs-pochees-sauce-epinards-coco.t: Poached Eggs in Spinach Coconut Milk Sauce
s: Heat the coconut oil in a 26 cm deep skillet over medium heat. Sauté the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 min.
Add the turmeric and cumin, then the spinach by handfuls, stirring until wilted (3 min).
Pour in the coconut milk, season with salt and simmer for 4 min until the sauce thickens.
Make 6 wells with a spoon and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5–7 min over low heat, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Serve directly from the skillet.
l01-oeufs-pochees-sauce-epinards-coco.p: A green, fragrant alternative to shakshuka, inspired by Indian egg curries.

l01-oeufs-au-plat-sauce-verte-harissa.t: Eggs Simmered with Green Peppers and Harissa
i: green bell peppers, cut into strips
s: Heat the oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Sauté the peppers for 8 min, until tender.
Add the zucchini, garlic, harissa and caraway. Season with salt, cover and cook for 5 min.
Add 3 tbsp water if the mixture sticks, then make 6 wells.
Crack an egg into each well, cover and cook for 5–6 min over low heat.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.
l01-oeufs-au-plat-sauce-verte-harissa.p: A tomato-free version, greener and lower in carbs than traditional shakshuka.

l01-shakshuka-blanche-yaourt.t: Turkish Poached Eggs with Garlic Yogurt and Chili Butter
s: Mix the yogurt with the grated garlic and a pinch of salt. Spread it over 2 shallow bowls and let it come back to room temperature.
Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer with the vinegar. Crack each egg into a cup.
Create a gentle swirl and slide the eggs in one at a time; poach for 3 min, then lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan until foaming, remove from the heat and add the paprika.
Place 2 eggs on each bowl of yogurt, drizzle with the chili butter and sprinkle with dill. Serve immediately.
l01-shakshuka-blanche-yaourt.p: This is the Turkish "çılbır". Very fresh eggs hold together much better when poached.

l01-wrap-oeuf-dinde-avocat.t: Egg Wrap with Smoked Turkey and Avocado
s: Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt. Lightly oil a 24 cm skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs, tilt the pan to cover the whole base and cook for 1 min 30 s, then flip for 30 s. Repeat with the other 2 eggs.
Let the egg crêpes cool slightly on a board.
Spread each with mayonnaise, then arrange the lettuce, smoked turkey and sliced avocado on top.
Season with pepper, roll up tightly and cut in half on the diagonal.
l01-wrap-oeuf-dinde-avocat.p: The egg crêpes can be made the day before and keep for 2 days in the refrigerator, separated by parchment paper.

l01-wrap-oeuf-thon-concombre.t: Egg Wrap with Tuna, Cucumber and Cream Cheese
i: small can of tuna in water
s: Mix the drained tuna with the cream cheese, lemon, chives and pepper.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Cook 2 thin egg crêpes in a lightly oiled 24 cm skillet (1 min 30 s on one side, 30 s on the other).
Let them cool slightly, then spread the tuna cream over each.
Arrange the cucumber sticks along one edge.
Roll up tightly, wrap in parchment paper and cut in half.
l01-wrap-oeuf-thon-concombre.p: Perfect for a breakfast on the go: the parchment paper stops the wrap from unrolling.

l01-burrito-oeuf-kefta-fromage.t: Keto Burrito with Scrambled Eggs, Kefta and Cheddar
i: ground kefta meat (spiced ground beef or lamb)
s: Beat 4 eggs with a pinch of salt and cook 2 large egg crêpes in a lightly oiled 26 cm skillet. Set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the kefta with the pepper and spices for 5 min, crumbling the meat.
Add the 2 remaining beaten eggs and scramble for 1–2 min with the meat.
Fill each egg crêpe with this mixture, some cheddar and a spoonful of crème fraîche.
Fold in the sides, then roll up like a burrito. Return to the skillet for 1 min per side to melt the cheese.
l01-burrito-oeuf-kefta-fromage.p: Add a spoonful of harissa to the crème fraîche for a spicy sauce.

s: Grate the zucchini, salt it and let it drain in a colander for 10 min.
Squeeze firmly in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much water as possible.
Mix the zucchini with the eggs, Parmesan, almond flour, garlic, dill and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and flatten to 1 cm thick.
Cook for 3 min per side, until well browned. Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with garlicky Greek yogurt.
l01-galettes-courgette-fromage.p: Do not overcrowd the pan: no more than 4 fritters at a time so they stay crispy.

l01-galettes-chou-fleur-cheddar.t: Cauliflower Fritters with Cheddar and Cumin
s: Pulse the cauliflower into fine rice-like crumbs. Cook for 4 min in the microwave (or 5 min in a dry skillet), then let cool.
Squeeze the cauliflower in a kitchen towel to remove the moisture.
Mix with the eggs, cheddar, almond flour, cumin, chives, salt and pepper.
Shape 8 fritters of 8 cm with damp hands.
Brown for 4 min per side in hot oil over medium heat, turning them gently.
Serve hot, with a fried egg if you like.
l01-galettes-chou-fleur-cheddar.p: You can also bake them at 200 °C for 20 min on parchment paper, turning them halfway through.

s: Grate the celeriac using the coarse holes of a grater. Salt and let sit for 5 min, then squeeze in a kitchen towel.
Mix with the egg, almond flour, thinly sliced scallion, paprika and pepper.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Drop in 6 mounds of the mixture and flatten them thinly with a spatula.
Cook for 5 min without touching, until the underside is well browned and crispy.
Flip and continue for 4–5 min. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
l01-hash-brown-celeri-rave.p: Serve with a fried egg and a few slices of smoked salmon for a complete brunch.

l01-avocat-farci-thon-mayo.t: Tuna-Stuffed Avocado with Lemony Mayonnaise and Paprika
s: Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits and sprinkle the flesh with a few drops of lemon.
Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, the remaining lemon, red onion, parsley, salt and pepper.
Scoop out the hollow of each avocado half slightly, add the scooped flesh to the filling and fill generously.
Dust with paprika and serve chilled.
l01-avocat-farci-thon-mayo.p: Lemon stops the avocado from turning brown: prepare them at the last minute or cover with plastic wrap pressed against the surface.

l01-avocat-oeuf-mollet-dukkah.t: Avocado with Soft-Boiled Egg and Almond Dukkah
s: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6 min, then plunge into ice water. Peel gently.
Dry-toast the almonds, sesame, cumin and coriander for 3 min in a skillet, then crush in a mortar with a pinch of salt: this is the dukkah.
Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits and drizzle with lemon and olive oil.
Place half a soft-boiled egg in the hollow of each avocado half.
Sprinkle generously with dukkah and serve.
l01-avocat-oeuf-mollet-dukkah.p: Dukkah keeps for 2 weeks in a jar: make a bigger batch for your salads.

l01-avocat-saumon-fume-fromage-frais.t: Avocado with Smoked Salmon and Dill Cream Cheese
s: Mix the cream cheese with the dill, a few drops of lemon and pepper.
Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits and sprinkle with lemon.
Fill the hollow of each avocado half with a spoonful of dill cheese.
Roll the salmon slices into little roses and place on top.
Season with pepper and serve immediately.
l01-avocat-saumon-fume-fromage-frais.p: Replace the salmon with cooked shrimp for a change.

l01-avocat-gratine-oeuf-cheddar.t: Baked Avocado with Egg, Cheddar and Chives
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the avocados in half, remove the pits and enlarge the hollow slightly with a spoon.
Wedge the avocado halves in a small dish (with crumpled aluminium foil to keep them upright).
Separate the eggs; place half a white and then a yolk in each hollow. Season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with cheddar and bake for 12–15 min, until the white is set.
Dust with sweet paprika and chives, and serve hot.
l01-avocat-gratine-oeuf-cheddar.p: Using only part of the white stops it from overflowing: keep the rest for an omelette.

l01-guacamole-oeufs-durs-bowl.t: Guacamole Bowl with Hard-Boiled Eggs and Pumpkin Seeds
s: Cook the eggs for 9 min in boiling water, cool them and peel.
Mash the avocado flesh with the lemon, red onion, chili, half the cilantro and salt.
Toast the pumpkin seeds for 2 min in a dry skillet.
Divide the guacamole between 2 bowls, add the eggs cut into quarters and the cherry tomatoes cut in half.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and the remaining cilantro, and serve.
l01-guacamole-oeufs-durs-bowl.p: Hard-boiled eggs keep for 4 days in the refrigerator in their shells: make a dozen on Sunday.

l01-bowl-oeufs-mollets-halloumi.t: Savory Bowl with Grilled Halloumi, Soft-Boiled Eggs and Spinach
s: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6 min 30 s, then plunge into ice water. Peel.
Grill the halloumi for 2 min per side in a hot pan with no added fat.
Mix the olive oil, lemon and pepper for the dressing.
Divide the spinach and sliced cucumber between 2 bowls and drizzle with the dressing.
Add the halloumi, the eggs cut in half and the olives, and sprinkle with za'atar.
l01-bowl-oeufs-mollets-halloumi.p: Halloumi is best eaten hot: grill it at the last moment, as it turns rubbery when it cools.

l01-toast-keto-avocat-oeuf-poche.t: Quick Keto Toast with Smashed Avocado and Poached Egg
s: Quick bread: in 2 mugs or small square bowls, mix for each 3 tbsp almond flour, 1 egg, half the melted butter, ½ tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Microwave for 90 seconds (800 W), turn out and cut each loaf into 2 slices.
Brown the slices for 1 min per side in a dry skillet or in the toaster.
Mash the avocado with a fork with the lemon, salt and pepper.
Bring vinegared water to a gentle simmer, slide in the eggs and poach for 3 min. Drain on paper towels.
Spread the toasts with avocado, top two of them with a poached egg and sprinkle with chili pepper.
l01-toast-keto-avocat-oeuf-poche.p: The quick bread can also be baked in the oven: 12 min at 180 °C in a small buttered tin.

l01-croque-keto-dinde-emmental.t: Keto Croque with Smoked Turkey and Emmental
s: Quick bread: in 2 mugs or small square bowls, mix for each 3 tbsp almond flour, 1 egg, half the melted butter, ½ tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Microwave for 90 seconds (800 W), turn out and cut each loaf into 2 slices.
Preheat the oven broiler (grill). Mix the crème fraîche with the mustard and pepper.
Spread 2 slices with this mixture, top with smoked turkey and half the Emmental, then close with the other 2 slices.
Spread the remaining cream on top and sprinkle with the remaining Emmental.
Place under the broiler for 4–5 min, until the cheese is golden and bubbling. Serve immediately.
l01-croque-keto-dinde-emmental.p: In a skillet: brown the croques for 2 min per side in a little butter, with a lid on to melt the cheese.

l01-toast-keto-ricotta-tomates-basilic.t: Keto Toasts with Ricotta, Cherry Tomatoes and Basil
s: Quick bread: in 2 mugs or small square bowls, mix for each 3 tbsp almond flour, 1 egg, half the melted butter, ½ tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Microwave for 90 seconds (800 W), turn out and cut each loaf into 2 slices.
Toast the slices for 1 min per side.
Season the ricotta with a pinch of salt and pepper and spread it on the toasts.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and arrange them on top.
Drizzle with olive oil, add the shredded basil and serve.
l01-toast-keto-ricotta-tomates-basilic.p: Moroccan variation: replace the ricotta with jben (fresh white cheese) and the basil with mint.

l01-crepes-salees-epinards-fromage.t: Savory Keto Crêpes with Spinach and Cream Cheese
s: Blend the eggs, cream cheese, almond flour and a pinch of salt until you have a smooth batter. Let rest for 5 min.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in 5 g of butter (2 min), squeeze it dry, chop it, then mix with the ricotta, Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Lightly butter a 20 cm skillet over medium-low heat. Pour in a small ladle of batter and spread it by tilting the pan.
Cook for 2 min, until the edges lift away, then flip gently with a spatula and cook for 30 s. Repeat to make 8 crêpes.
Fill each crêpe with the filling, roll up and serve warm.
l01-crepes-salees-epinards-fromage.p: These crêpes are fragile: keep them small (20 cm) and flip them with a wide spatula.

l01-galette-complete-keto.t: Keto Galette Complète with Egg, Turkey and Emmental
i: eggs (2 for the batter, 2 for topping)
s: Whisk the almond flour, flax, 2 eggs, almond milk and a pinch of salt. Let rest for 5 min so the flax thickens the batter.
Melt a little butter in a 26 cm skillet over medium heat. Pour in half the batter and spread it thinly. Cook for 2 min, then flip.
Sprinkle with half the Emmental, add half the turkey and crack an egg into the center.
Cover and cook for 3–4 min, until the white is set.
Fold the edges into a square around the yolk, season with pepper and serve. Repeat for the second galette.
l01-galette-complete-keto.p: Add a few pan-fried mushrooms for a "forestière" version.

l01-bowl-yaourt-sale-concombre.t: Savory Greek Yogurt Bowl with Cucumber, Mint and Seeds
s: Mix the yogurt with the grated garlic, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Toast the pumpkin seeds and crushed walnuts for 3 min in a dry skillet, then mix with the ground flax.
Divide the yogurt between 2 bowls and make a slight hollow in the center.
Add the diced cucumber and the shredded mint.
Sprinkle with the toasted seeds and drizzle with olive oil.
l01-bowl-yaourt-sale-concombre.p: Add a soft-boiled egg or a few olives for a more filling bowl.

l01-riz-chou-fleur-saute-oeufs.t: Stir-Fried Cauliflower Rice with Eggs and Scallions
s: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic, ginger and the white parts of the scallions for 1 min.
Add the cauliflower rice and stir-fry for 5 min, until tender but still firm.
Push the cauliflower to one side, add the remaining oil and pour in the beaten eggs. Scramble for 1 min, then mix into the cauliflower.
Drizzle with soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 more min.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the scallions and the sesame, and serve hot.
l01-riz-chou-fleur-saute-oeufs.p: Add leftover chicken or shrimp to make it a complete meal.

l01-oeufs-benedicte-keto.t: Keto Eggs Benedict on Quick Bread with Hollandaise
s: Quick bread: in 2 mugs or small square bowls, mix for each 3 tbsp almond flour, 1 egg, half the melted butter, ½ tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Microwave for 90 seconds (800 W), turn out and cut each loaf into 2 slices.
Hollandaise: melt the butter for the sauce. Over a barely simmering water bath, whisk the yolks with 1 tbsp water until thickened and pale (2–3 min).
Off the heat, pour in the melted butter in a thin stream while whisking constantly, then add the lemon and a pinch of salt. Keep warm over lukewarm water.
Poach the eggs for 3 min in simmering vinegared water, then drain.
Toast the 4 slices. For each plate, top one slice with smoked turkey and a poached egg, coat with hollandaise, and serve the second slice alongside for dipping.
l01-oeufs-benedicte-keto.p: If the hollandaise splits, whisk a spoonful of hot water in a clean bowl and gradually whisk the sauce into it.

s: Preheat the waffle iron and lightly brush it with butter.
Mix the eggs, mozzarella, almond flour, chives, garlic powder and pepper.
Pour a quarter of the batter into the center of the waffle iron, close and cook for 3–4 min, until the waffle is golden and crisp.
Repeat to make 4 waffles and leave them for 1 min on a rack so they crisp up.
Serve spread with cream cheese.
l01-gaufres-salees-fromage-chaffles.p: They also work as sandwich bread: fill them with smoked turkey and lettuce.

l01-quiche-sans-pate-epinards-chevre.t: Crustless Quiche with Spinach and Goat Cheese
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter a 24 cm pie dish.
Sauté the onion in the rest of the butter for 3 min, add the spinach and let it wilt for 3 min. Squeeze out the water.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread the spinach in the dish, pour in the egg mixture and arrange the goat cheese rounds on top.
Bake for 28–30 min, until the quiche is puffed, golden and firm in the center.
Let cool for 10 min before cutting into 6 slices.
l01-quiche-sans-pate-epinards-chevre.p: Keeps for 4 days in the refrigerator; reheat a slice for 1 min in the microwave or eat it cold.

i: ground kefta meat (spiced ground beef or lamb)
cumin, paprika and ras el hanout
s: Boil the eggs for 7 min, plunge them into ice water and peel.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the kefta with the herbs, spices, salt and pepper; divide into 4 portions.
Flatten each portion in your damp palm, place an egg in the center and wrap it completely, smoothing the meat well.
Roll each ball in the almond flour, place on a tray lined with parchment paper and brush with oil.
Bake for 22–25 min, turning halfway through, until the meat is well browned and cooked through (70 °C at the center).
Let rest for 5 min and cut in half to serve.
l01-scotch-eggs-kefta.p: For a still-creamy yolk, reduce the egg cooking time to 6 min and handle them with care.

l01-tofu-brouille-curcuma.t: Turmeric Scrambled Tofu with Spinach and Cherry Tomatoes
s: Drain the tofu and press it between two kitchen towels for 5 min to remove the water.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the scallion for 1 min.
Crumble the tofu by hand into the skillet, add the turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper. Cook for 5 min, stirring.
Add the coconut milk to make the mixture creamy, then the spinach and the tomatoes cut in half. Cook for 2 min.
Serve immediately, generously peppered.
l01-tofu-brouille-curcuma.p: A 100% plant-based version of scrambled eggs, ideal for family members who do not eat eggs.

l01-poelee-merguez-oeufs-poivrons.t: Merguez Skillet with Fried Eggs and Grilled Peppers
s: Cut the merguez into 3 cm pieces and brown for 5 min in a large skillet over medium heat, with no added fat. Pour off some of the rendered fat.
Add the oil, onion and the peppers cut into strips. Sauté for 6–7 min until tender and lightly charred.
Make 3 spaces in the pan and crack the eggs into them. Lightly salt the whites.
Cover and cook for 3–4 min over low heat, until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve straight from the pan.
l01-poelee-merguez-oeufs-poivrons.p: Choose halal butcher-shop merguez with a high meat content and no breadcrumbs.

l01-oeufs-coque-mouillettes-asperges.t: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Parmesan Asparagus Soldiers
s: Trim the tough ends from the asparagus. Sauté for 4–5 min in the butter over medium heat, until tender and lightly golden. Season with salt.
Meanwhile, bring a pan of water to a boil and gently lower in the room-temperature eggs with a spoon.
Cook for 3 min 30 s for a nicely runny yolk, then remove.
Roll the hot asparagus in the Parmesan.
Place the eggs in egg cups, crack off the tops and dip the asparagus soldiers in.
l01-oeufs-coque-mouillettes-asperges.p: When asparagus is out of season, use pan-fried zucchini sticks or strips of grilled halloumi.

s: In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs with the softened cream cheese until smooth and lump-free.
Add the almond milk and vanilla, then the almond flour, erythritol, baking powder and salt. Mix just enough to get a thick batter.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes: the almond flour absorbs the liquid and the pancakes will hold together better.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and grease it with a little butter.
Pour 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake and spread slightly. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges set.
Gently flip with a thin spatula and cook for 1 to 2 more minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter, regreasing the pan.
Serve warm with a few raspberries or a spoonful of Greek yogurt.
l02-pancakes-amande-moelleux.p: Cook over low heat: almond flour browns faster than wheat flour. The pancakes can be frozen separated by parchment paper and reheated in the toaster.

s: Whisk the eggs and fromage blanc in a mixing bowl until smooth.
Add the coconut flour, erythritol, baking powder, shredded coconut and salt. Mix, then let rest for 10 minutes: the batter will thicken considerably.
If the batter is too stiff, loosen it with 1 to 2 tablespoons of water: it should coat the spoon.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat with a little coconut oil spread with a paper towel.
Form small 8 cm pancakes (they are more fragile than classic ones) and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Keep them warm under a kitchen towel while you cook the rest.
l02-pancakes-coco-fromage-blanc.p: Coconut flour is very absorbent: do not swap it for almond flour at equal weight (you need about 3 times more almond flour).

s: Separate the whites from the yolks. Mix the yolks with the ricotta, lemon juice and zest, and erythritol.
Fold in the almond flour and baking powder until smooth.
Whip the whites with the pinch of salt to stiff peaks, then fold them in in two batches with a spatula, lifting the batter without deflating it.
Melt a little butter in a skillet over low heat.
Drop in ladlefuls of batter, cover and cook for 3 minutes, then flip and cook for 2 more minutes.
Serve right away, they are very airy straight from the pan.
l02-pancakes-ricotta-citron.p: The lid lets the center cook without burning the underside. Delicious with a few blackberries crushed with a fork.

s: Preheat the waffle iron and lightly brush it with melted butter.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, the slightly cooled melted butter and the vanilla.
Add the almond flour, erythritol, baking powder and salt. Mix to a thick, smooth batter.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the center of each grid, close and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, without opening too early.
Once the steam almost stops escaping, gently lift out with a fork.
Place the waffles on a rack for 2 minutes so they crisp up, then serve.
l02-gaufres-amande-vanille.p: Placing the waffles on a rack rather than in a stack stops them from going soft. They reheat very well in the toaster.

s: Preheat a waffle iron (ideally a mini waffle iron).
Beat the eggs with a fork, then add the mozzarella, almond flour, erythritol, cinnamon and vanilla.
Pour a quarter of the batter into the hot waffle iron, close and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the chaffle is well browned.
Remove and let cool for 1 minute on a rack: it firms up and becomes crisp.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve dusted with a little erythritol mixed with cinnamon.
l02-chaffles-sucrees-cannelle.p: The cheese flavor almost disappears during cooking. Add a spoonful of cocoa for a chocolate version.

s: Blend the eggs, cream cheese, coconut flour, erythritol, vanilla and salt in a blender until the batter is perfectly smooth.
Let rest for 5 minutes so the bubbles settle.
Heat a 20 cm non-stick skillet over medium heat and grease it with a knob of butter.
Pour in a small ladle of batter, tilting the pan to cover the whole base in a thin layer.
Cook for about 1 minute 30 seconds, until the edges lift away, then flip gently with a wide spatula and cook for 30 seconds.
Stack the crêpes on a plate and top with raspberries and whipped cream.
l02-crepes-fromage-creme.p: These crêpes are more fragile than classic crêpes: choose a small pan and do not make them too big.

l02-crepes-cacao-noisette.t: Cocoa Crêpes with Homemade Hazelnut Spread
s: Spread: blend the toasted hazelnuts for a long time (5 to 8 minutes), scraping down the sides, until you get a runny paste.
Add the coconut oil, the cocoa set aside for the spread and 1 tablespoon of erythritol, blend for 1 more minute and set aside.
Crêpe batter: blend the eggs, cream cheese, the rest of the cocoa and erythritol, and the salt until smooth.
Heat a small buttered non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pour in a thin layer of batter and cook for 1 minute 30 seconds, then flip for 30 seconds.
Spread each crêpe with a spoonful of hazelnut spread, fold in four and serve.
l02-crepes-cacao-noisette.p: The hazelnut spread keeps for a week in a jar at room temperature; stir it before use.

s: In a small saucepan, mix the ground flax, coconut, chia, almond flour, cinnamon and salt.
Pour in the coconut milk and water, then bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes over low heat, still stirring, until the porridge thickens.
Remove from the heat, sweeten with the erythritol and let rest for 2 minutes: it keeps thickening.
Serve in bowls and top with a few raspberries or flaked almonds.
l02-porridge-coco-lin.p: Prepare the dry mix in a large batch in a jar: in the morning, just add the liquid.

l02-porridge-oeuf-creme-vanille.t: Warm Egg Porridge, Vanilla Custard Style
s: In a saucepan, mix the almond flour, flax and almond milk. Heat over low heat until simmering.
Beat the egg in a bowl. Whisk in 3 spoonfuls of the hot mixture to temper it.
Pour everything back into the saucepan and whisk constantly over very low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until creamy (without boiling, to avoid lumps).
Off the heat, add the butter, vanilla and erythritol.
Pour into a bowl and top with raspberries.
l02-porridge-oeuf-creme-vanille.p: The secret is very low heat: if the egg curdles, blitz for a few seconds with an immersion blender to rescue the texture.

l02-pudding-chia-vanille-framboise.t: Vanilla Chia Pudding with Raspberry Coulis
s: In a jar, whisk the coconut milk, almond milk, vanilla and half the erythritol.
Add the chia seeds, whisk for 30 seconds, wait 5 minutes, then whisk again to prevent lumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Coulis: crush the raspberries with a fork with the remaining erythritol and the lemon juice (heat for 3 minutes if frozen).
Divide the pudding among 4 small glasses and top with coulis just before serving.
l02-pudding-chia-vanille-framboise.p: Keeps for 4 days in the refrigerator: prepare the glasses on Sunday for the whole week.

s: Whisk the almond milk with the coconut cream, cocoa, erythritol and salt until the cocoa is fully dissolved.
Add the chia seeds, whisk, wait 5 minutes and whisk again.
Divide among 3 jars, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Toast the hazelnuts for 4 minutes in a dry skillet, then crush coarsely.
Sprinkle the puddings with hazelnuts just before serving so they stay crunchy.
l02-pudding-chia-cacao.p: For a mousse-like texture, blend the set pudding with an immersion blender.

l02-chia-coco-citron-menthe.t: Coconut, Lemon and Mint Chia Pudding
s: Mix the coconut milk, lemon juice and zest, and erythritol.
Add the chia seeds and shredded mint, whisk, then repeat after 5 minutes.
Let set for at least 4 hours in the refrigerator.
Toast the coconut for 2 minutes in a dry skillet, stirring.
Serve chilled, sprinkled with toasted coconut and a mint leaf.
l02-chia-coco-citron-menthe.p: Lemon zest adds lots of fragrance without carbs: use an unwaxed lemon.

l02-bowl-yaourt-fruits-rouges.t: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Berries and Seeds
s: Whisk the Greek yogurt with a spoon for 30 seconds to make it creamier, and sweeten lightly with stevia if you like.
Pour it into a wide bowl.
Quickly toast the flaked almonds and pumpkin seeds for 2 minutes in a dry skillet.
Arrange the raspberries and blackberries on the yogurt, then sprinkle with the toasted seeds and the chia.
Enjoy immediately.
l02-bowl-yaourt-fruits-rouges.p: Choose a full-fat plain Greek yogurt and read the label: some brands add sugar or starch.

l02-bowl-yaourt-fraise-pistache.t: Yogurt Bowl with Strawberries and Crushed Pistachios
s: Mix the yogurt with the erythritol and vanilla.
Wash, hull and quarter the strawberries.
Coarsely chop the pistachios with a knife.
Divide the yogurt between two bowls, add the strawberries and a drizzle of almond butter loosened slightly with a spoonful of water.
Sprinkle with pistachios and serve.
l02-bowl-yaourt-fraise-pistache.p: Pistachios are higher in carbs than other nuts: use them as decorative crushed pieces rather than a big handful.

s: Make a keto amlou: mix the almond butter, argan oil and erythritol until you have a smooth cream.
Divide the fromage blanc between two bowls.
Place a spoonful of keto amlou in the center and swirl it lightly with the spoon.
Sprinkle with toasted crushed almonds and raspberries.
Serve immediately.
l02-bowl-fromage-blanc-amlou.p: Edible (roasted) argan oil gives amlou its true flavor; do not replace it with cosmetic oil.

l02-granola-noix-coco.t: Crunchy Keto Nut and Coconut Granola
s: Preheat the oven to 150 °C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Coarsely chop the almonds, walnuts and hazelnuts with a knife (or pulse in a food processor).
Whisk the egg white until frothy, then add the melted coconut oil, erythritol, vanilla, cinnamon and salt.
Pour over the nuts, coconut and seeds, and mix to coat everything well.
Spread in a thin layer on the tray, pressing lightly to form clusters.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the granola is golden.
Let cool completely on the tray without touching it: it hardens as it cools. Then break into pieces.
l02-granola-noix-coco.p: Keeps for 3 weeks in an airtight jar. One portion (about 50 g) is served with Greek yogurt or almond milk.
